verdict.rationale: Weaviate's first-party backup docs describe backing up an entire instance or only selected collections, storing backups in S3, GCS or Azure, taking incremental backups, and restoring them, including across storage providers. Restore is only mentioned briefly, and no hands-on report corroborates it. missing for 10: detailed restore workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of backup/restore reliability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them

citations.quote: Choice of backing up an entire instance, or selected collections only
Backup and Restore between different storage providers
Seamless integration with widely-used cloud blob storage, such as AWS S3, GCS, or Azure Storage
Incremental backups that only store changed data, reducing backup and speeding up backup times
